svg.title: Dashboard concept with synthetic data
svg.desc: A concept of a project dashboard, with synthetic data. example-project release 0.4.0 is Verifying, with 7 of 10 tasks verified and one approval waiting. The next authorised action is to re-run checks on task 09. Work in flight has a coordinator and three AI workers on a cache layer, parser fix and user guide. Independent checks show 1,284 tests passed, two of three reviews done and 14 of 14 claims confirmed on re-run. Human approvals show a release waiting, a budget increase approved and a push to main approved. Capacity shows 62 percent left in pool A and 18 percent left in pool B.
